request: Got a monitor hunt on my hands, and the resolution has to land on 3440 x 1440 (I'll double-check the listing myself, don't worry). And it's got to be one you've actually got on hand there, not one that only exists on some website somewhere down the trail. Nothing over 18000 cts, y'all (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves, and yes, every penny counts for me). My last order showed up with the wrong cable, so I'm double-checking everything before I spend another dime. This monitor will sit on a desk in my rental room, where I do stats homework, cut video for a class project, and play a few rounds with my cousin on weekends. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). (Yes, I know full well that's a lot of trail for one screen, but it's all I've got.) I'm skeptical of fancy claims, though I'll gladly hear what's honestly worth paying extra for.
